signature: overseer-obs:anomaly:distill parse-fail rate 100% + blocked-goal + process:distill_fail + quality:gym_skipped + resource:engineer_spawn + workstream-gap (seen 2x)
root_cause: scan_cleaned_for_facts (distillation.rs:1289) uses strict serde_json::from_str::<RecipeEnvelope> (L1291 fast path / L1312 per-span). A trailing comma keeps braces balanced (passes recipe_output::balanced_objects) but strict serde rejects it -> every span Err -> None -> parse_facts_document Err -> deferred forever = 100% parse-fail. No lenient recovery exists.

tracks.P0: In-repo code fix: string-aware trailing-comma recovery + observability. Blocks everything; gates acceptance C1.
tracks.P1: Telemetry/orchestration hand-off (overseer self-heal verify, stale-goal expiry, gym-gate, kgpacks #16/#17). Minimal in-repo code; tracks kept independent (coupling is correlational, not causal).

database_design: N/A. Verified no relational/graph schema, migration, index, or constraint is touched. Persistence at all change sites is flat-file: in-memory JSON strings (parse), append-only ~/.simard/metrics/metrics.jsonl (metric), status::json / OpenOptions files (overseer). rusqlite is used ONLY in gym_history + native_knowledge (neither a P0 site); P1.3 reuses gym_history schema unchanged via CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS.

components.name: Brick A - strip_json_trailing_commas
components.purpose: New shared, string-aware, total fn in recipe_output::extract that removes JSON-illegal trailing commas (a ',' whose next non-ws byte is '}' or ']'), honoring string literals and '\"'/'\\' escapes. Returns Cow (Borrowed on clean path = zero alloc). Mirrors scan_balanced's in_string/escaped byte machine. Iterative O(n), no recursion, no panic.

components.name: Brick B - scan_cleaned_for_facts recovery tier
components.purpose: In distillation.rs:1289, for the fast path (L1291) and each balanced span (L1312): try strict serde first; ONLY on Err, retry strict serde on strip_json_trailing_commas(candidate).as_ref(). Preserves 3 preference tiers, END-first span order, and never-a-hollow-Ok (malformed still -> None -> Err -> retry-safe defer).

components.name: Brick C - zero-facts-after-filter warn
components.purpose: In RecipeEnvelope::into_output (distillation.rs:1497), emit a distinct tracing::warn!(target:"simard::distill", input_facts, kept_facts=0, ...) IFF pre_filter_len > 0 && kept == 0, so 'parsed OK, all facts category-filtered' is never conflated with a parse failure. Count-only, no content. Legitimately empty {"facts":[]} does NOT warn.

components.name: Brick D - ParseRecovery per-pass metric discriminator
components.purpose: New pub enum ParseRecovery {StrictOk, Recovered, Deferred, ZeroFacts} with frozen as_str() labels (strict-ok|recovered|deferred|zero-facts). Thread as one appended arg into build_distill_success_context (distillation.rs:825) -> append-only 'parse_recovery' key in metrics.jsonl context. Decision D-1: reuse existing distill_success_rate/distill_parse_success_rate channel (no new metric name, unchanged denominators). Best-effort, test-silent. Distinct from existing recovered_after_retry (whole-runner re-invocation, #2468).

components.name: Brick E - regression + unit tests
components.purpose: Unit tests for Brick A (extract.rs #[cfg(test)]) incl. adversarial inputs; regression tests for Bricks B/C (distillation.rs in-module + distillation_tests.rs) mapped to acceptance C1-C5 and security S1/S2.

risks: R1/S2 (High): string-aware stripper corrupts a comma INSIDE a string literal preceding }/] (e.g. {"c":"a,}"}) -> content corruption. Mitigation: mirror scan_balanced in_string/escaped machine exactly; dedicated tests (comma-in-string, escaped-quote-then-comma, emoji/multi-byte).

R2/S1 (High): over-tolerance masks genuinely broken agent output / lets hostile structure in. Mitigation: trailing-comma-only + repair-on-Err-only + never-hollow-Ok; malformed still Err (retry-safe); test genuinely_malformed_still_err.

R3 (Med): recovery hides a real recurring agent bug behind auto-repair. Mitigation: ParseRecovery::Recovered is telemetered distinctly from StrictOk -> high recovery share is queryable and drives a prompt fix.
R4 (Low): zero-facts warn floods logs on legitimately empty batches. Mitigation: warn only when pre_filter_len>0 && kept==0.
R5 (Med): branch sprawl (#2495/#2619/#2622/#2658 touch same parse path) -> merge conflict. Mitigation: base already absorbed #2622/#2619; build fix fresh (#2658 empty); rebase before PR.

R6 (Med): P1 goal/gym/workstream state is largely operational/out-of-repo -> over-scoping into code = hollow work. Mitigation: P1 code strictly limited to a verified gym regression; goal-expiry + kgpacks are telemetry/hand-off.
R7 (Med): correlational coupling misread as causal (expecting P0 to clear blocked-goal signals). Mitigation: tracks kept independent; C1/C2 gate on distill, C3-C5 gate on their own steps.

S3 (Med): unbounded facts-file read (harvest_facts_file, read_to_string, no cap) -> OOM, worsened 2x by Owned repair copy. Mitigation: SHOULD cap read to a few MiB; oversize -> retry-safe ParseFailure.
S4 (Med): pathological deep-nesting -> stack/CPU DoS or panic. Mitigation: iterative O(n) repair (no recursion); rely on serde 128-depth bound (do not raise); totality guarantee.
S8 (Med): silent stale-block self-heal clears a LEGITIMATE block. Mitigation: idempotent + audit-logged self-heal.
security_considerations: No new authn/authz surface, network listener, or IPC endpoint (AA-1). Subprocess keeps parent's existing local privilege (AA-2).
IV-1 Totality/no-panic: strip_json_trailing_commas total over any &str (unterminated string, lone backslash at EOF, no closer, all-commas, empty, whitespace-only) -> Cow, never panics.
IV-2 UTF-8 boundary safety: scan bytes but branch only on ASCII (, } ] \" \\ and ASCII ws); owned rebuild reuses original byte spans; multi-byte/emoji content preserved.
IV-3 String-literal awareness: commas/braces/brackets inside "..." untouched, honoring \" and \\; adversarial tests required.
IV-4 Minimality: remove ONLY a ',' whose next non-ws byte is '}' or ']'; no json5/comments/quote-fixing.
IV-5 Strict-first, repair-on-Err-only: serde_json stays the single validity arbiter at both L1291 and L1312.
IV-6 Never a hollow Ok: input parsing under neither view -> None -> Err -> defer (anti-injection invariant; no unvalidated data enters DistillOutput).
IV-7 No new field leniency: do not widen de_lenient_string or RecipeEnvelope shape.

IV-8 Downstream content gates remain mandatory: grounded-capable tier, assess_fact_reliability quarantine, empty-concept drop, canonical_distill_concept/KNOWN_DISTILL_CONCEPTS. Prevents prompt-injected episode content (T0) riding the repair path into stored memory.

DP-1/2/3 Log hygiene: metrics context + zero-facts warn are counts + frozen-enum labels ONLY (no fact concept/content/source_episode_id/excerpt). ParseRecovery::as_str = four fixed ASCII strings (frozen vocabulary).
DP-4 Preserve tempfile 0700 unique-per-invocation dir + drop cleanup; no predictable /tmp path.
DP-6 Concurrent-append integrity: keep metrics.jsonl record < PIPE_BUF (4096B) so single write_all stays atomic; do not balloon context.
RD-1 (SHOULD) cap harvest_facts_file read; oversize -> ParseFailure (repair doubles peak memory).
RD-2/3/4 iterative O(n) repair, serde 128-depth bound intact, idempotent (single strict->repair->strict, no repair loop).
DP-5 (SHOULD) sanitize the 200-char error excerpt in truncate (control/newline/ANSI) to prevent log-forging.

P1 security: overseer/goal files persist structural data only (no secrets); gh issue bodies (#16/#17) carry no credentials/sensitive episode content; gym-gate restore closes a disabled control; self-heal idempotent + audit-logged.
Net effect: fix narrows the silent-drop failure WITHOUT widening the attack surface; parse_recovery=recovered doubles as the detection control for repair abuse/regression (S1).
